full_text: Unless otherwise provided in this Code, tax exemptions or incentives granted to, or presently enjoyed by all persons, whether natural or juridical, including government-owned or -controlled corporations, except local water districts, cooperatives duly registered under R.A. No. 6938, non-stock and non- profit hospitals and educational institutions, are hereby withdrawn upon the effectivity of this Code. CHAPTER 6 - TAXPAYER'S REMEDIES
